about: Every lufthansa.com document path that may be sent to DA as a page, exact paths only. da-upload.mjs allows a path in this list or in the migration scope (transformers/scope-paths.js) or in a document family (nav, footer, fragments, app screens, feeds: da-upload-sites.mjs); the import helper's runs read this list alone, so it also repeats the scope's published documents. It holds: the ch pilot (2026-10-27: the homepages and own pages of ch/en and ch/de, tools/reports/markets/inventory.json, and the market versions of the ch sweep, tools/reports/markets/ch-sweep.md); the market-root documents and the locale-gap roots added with the markets rollout; the import helper's own-document paths (standing order 3, 2026-11-11); and every published document of the census and the uploader's state, plus the planned own documents of the own-document lists (3af8ecd, 2026-11-11: 4,008 paths, 3,905 of them in the scope). Not here: the document families (allowed by pattern); the app shell (login, profile), which da-upload refuses even when listed; the German sign-in pages (anmeldung), kept out so no run overwrites them. Order: in batches as added, each batch in its own order.
